howToDeploy.question: How do I Deploy an Aplikasi?
howToDeploy.answer:
Ngedeploy on FluxCloud is simple:
  1. Click "Mulai Ngedeploy" to access the configuration Kaca
  2. Specify your Docker Gambar and configuration
  3. Choose your resources (CPU, RAM, Panyimpenan)
  4. Pilih Angka of Instans and deployment Lokasi
  5. Deploy and your Aplikasi will be live in menit

We Dhukungan Docker images from any registry including Docker Hub, GitHub Kontainer Registry, and pribadi registries.

pricing.question: How much does it Biaya?
pricing.answer:
FluxCloud offers transparent, Bayar-as-you-go pricing Mulai at just $0.99/sasi for Dasar configurations. Pricing depends on:
  • CPU cores allocated
  • RAM Jumlah
  • Panyimpenan Ukuran
  • Angka of Instans
  • Port requirements

Use our Biaya Calculator to estimate exact pricing for your needs. Ora hidden Biaya, Ora surprise charges.

  • Email Dhukungan: Direct assistance from our team

requirements.question: What are the requirements to Deploy?
requirements.answer:
To Deploy Aplikasi on FluxCloud you need:
  • A Flux ID: Gawe one for Gratis using any Flux-compatible Wallet
  • Docker Gambar: Your Aplikasi packaged as a Docker Kontainer
  • FLUX Token or USD: To Bayar for hosting (we Tampa credit cards via Stripe and PayPal)
  • Minimum 3 Instans: For decentralization and redundancy

Minimum resources per Instans: 0.1 CPU cores, 100 MB RAM, 1 GB Panyimpenan

security.question: Sepira amane FluxCloud?
security.answer:
FluxCloud implements multiple security layers:
  • Kontainer Isolation: Each Aplikasi runs in its own isolated Docker Kontainer
  • Encrypted Transfer: Kabeh data in transit is encrypted
  • DDoS Protection: Built-in protection against attacks
  • Regular Audits: Kode and infrastructure regularly audited
  • Desentralisasi: Ora single point of failure
  • pribadi Opsi: Enterprise mode for enhanced privacy

You maintain full control over your Aplikasi Kode and data.

whatIsOrbit.question: Apa iku Panyebaran Git?
whatIsOrbit.answer: Git Deployment is Flux's Git-based deployment platform that automatically builds and deploys your Aplikasi without requiring Docker knowledge. Just Sambungake your Repositori and Git deployment handles everything else—framework detection, dependency installation, building, and deployment across the Flux Jaringan.

whatFrameworks.question: Framework apa wae sing didhukung?
whatFrameworks.answer: Git deployment supports 100+ frameworks including Sabanjure.js, Django, FastAPI, Rails, Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, and many Luwih akeh. It auto-detects Node.js, Python, Rust, Go, Java, .NET, Ruby, PHP projects and static sites.

howBuildsWork.question: Piye cara kerja build?
howBuildsWork.answer: A Build is triggered every Wektu you Push Anyar commits to your Repositori. Git deployment detects the changes via webhooks, pulls your Kode, builds it using the detected framework, and deploys it across the Jaringan. Gratis Tingkat includes 50 builds Saben wulan.

exceedLimit.question: What happens when I exceed the Build limit?
exceedLimit.answer: When you reach the Gratis Tingkat limit (50 builds/sasi), you'll Tampa an Email Notifikasi. The Sabanjure Build will automatically Tingkatake your Aplikasi to Pro Tingkat ($15/sasi), and your credit Kartu will be charged.

switchPlans.question: Can I switch from Gratis to Pro?
switchPlans.answer: Ya! You can Tingkatake to Pro anytime from your Aplikasi Dasbor. You can also prepay for 3, 6, or 12 sasi when registering a Anyar Aplikasi.

privateRepos.question: Are pribadi repositories supported?
privateRepos.answer: Ya, Git deployment supports pribadi repositories. You'll need to authorize Git deployment to access your Repositori during the setup process.
